start.t: "Noa! Over here. Listen — the city stuttered this morning and you're the only other person who noticed. That makes you dangerous. And useful."

c.t: What do you mean, the city stuttered?

glitch.t: "At 8:03 the whole loop hiccupped. Half a second where nothing repeated. The Dev Office has equipment that can show you what I mean. Go there."

risk.t: "Staying asleep is riskier. The Architect rewrites citizens who ask too many questions. I'd rather be awake and careful."

who.t: "Barista by loop, anomaly by choice. I remember things the loop tries to delete. Like a garden that used to be in the northwest."

garden2.t: "Green, wild, unscripted. They paved it over with a park that resets every night. Fragments of it still flicker — you'll need the lens from the Dev Office to see them."

start.t: "Psst. You're the anomaly everyone's whispering about. I used to work for the Architect — maintenance division. Take this note. Don't read it where the lamps can see."

why.t: "Because the loop eats days, friend. Yours, mine, everyone's. If you're going to poke the core, someone who knows the wiring should be on your side."

start.t: "Still hunting the photo spots? Here — the light pools near the west park gate, the east overlook, and down by the harbor. Stand in the glow and the city poses for you."
